common.tagline: Padel in one link. No app, no account.

identity.nameHelp: Shown to other players. That's the whole signup.

landing.headline: Padel in one link.
landing.sub: Create a match, share the link on WhatsApp or Telegram, friends tap to join. No app, no accounts, no passwords.
landing.formTitle: Set up a match in 10 seconds
landing.formSub: Pick a time, get a link, share it. Players tap to join. No app, no signup.

create.title: New match
create.venuePlaceholder: Court TBD · or type a club
create.whenFullWaitlistHelp: Extra players queue up and move in automatically if someone drops out.
create.whenFullClosedHelp: No more joins once the spots are taken.

create.errPast: That time is already in the past.
create.venueHint: Leave empty if the court isn't booked yet.
create.tournamentHelp: Americano: partners rotate every round, most points wins. Rounds are generated on the day.

share.title: Your match is live
share.subtitle: Send the link. Friends tap, enter a name, they're in.
share.manageHint: Private — don't share. Open it on another device to manage this match.
share.emailHelp: Optional. Add your email to get a Google Calendar invite and updates when players join, leave or confirm.
share.emailSaved: Saved. We'll email you when something happens.

event.cancelledHelp: The organizer called it off. Nothing to do here.

creator.reserveHelp: Hold a spot for someone. You get a personal link to forward to them.

creator.rolodexHint: Start typing to pick from players you've played with.
creator.inviteAll: Send all invites in one message
creator.inviteAllHelp: One message listing each person's personal link. Good for a group chat.

me.identityHelp: Your identity lives in this browser. Same name, no password.
me.noIdentity: Enter your name to see your matches.

notFound.title: Link not found
notFound.body: That match link doesn't exist or was mistyped. Codes are 4 characters and case-sensitive.

invitePage.gone: This invitation is no longer valid.
invitePage.goneHelp: The spot was released or taken. You can still try the open match link.

cancelled.body: {organizer} cancelled the padel match on {day} at {time} at {venue}. Sorry! The calendar entry will be removed when you open the attachment.

homescreen.body: Next time it's one tap to your matches, like an app.
homescreen.iosHint: Tap the Share button below, then "Add to Home Screen".

americano.title: Americano
americano.howItWorks: Partners rotate every round, everyone plays everyone, most points wins. Sit-outs are shared evenly. Players who join later are included from the next round.
americano.needPlayers: Needs at least 4 players in the roster ({count} so far).
americano.deleteLastRoundConfirm: Delete round {n}? Only possible while it has no scores.
americano.finalizeConfirm: Lock all scores and publish the final standings? You can unlock later.
americano.enterHelp: Enter each court's points. Anyone in the tournament can fill in or correct scores until the organizer finalizes.
americano.notStarted: Score entry opens when the tournament starts. Rounds can be prepared now.
